Implemented on branch work/claude-strict-exp (standalone clone /private/tmp/eyes4s-claude-exp, base 9431e120), commit b6e20b7510a79cf0da8e63fed6d7fea9d4cf8b55, tree 782acaf7911fe47ff46681b2b0f70c2402a7ec46. Not pushed, not merged.

Change: Smoother.kernel calls private[surface] KernelExp: StrictMath.exp on JVM (surface/.jvm), math.exp on Scala.js (surface/.js; Scala.js has no StrictMath). New JVM-only KernelExpJvmSuite pins taps and a smoothed unit point (sigma 12 cells, 73x73) to StrictMath bit for bit.

Evidence (JDK 25.0.4.1; x86_64 = Temurin x64 under Rosetta):
- 1,002,035 kernel args (sigma 0.2..32.2 cells): aarch64 math.exp == StrictMath on all (aarch64 HotSpot has no exp intrinsic); x86_64 math.exp differs on 90,298 (9.0%), max abs 1.1e-16, max rel 2.2e-16; -XX:-UseLibmIntrinsic removes all differences. Node 24 V8 Math.exp differs from fdlibm on 493 (0.05%).
- Therefore no fixture/golden changes on aarch64 (bit-identical). Unrounded studio-golden scores: x86 old vs x86 new differ on 3799/5956 values, max abs 7.8e-16, max rel 1.7e-13; x86 new == aarch64 bit for bit (full precision). SCORES.json regenerates byte-for-byte on x86 both before and after (6-decimal rounding absorbed it).
- Mutation (KernelExp -> math.exp): KernelExpJvmSuite fails 2/2 on x86_64, passes on aarch64 (equivalent mutant there).
- Perf (Renormalise, 200 pts): per-estimate time unchanged within noise, e.g. 256x256 sigma 32 cells: arm 20.47 ms old vs 20.49 ms new; x86/Rosetta 22.94 ms old vs 22.74 ms new; 64x48 sigma 32: x86 1.08 vs 1.10 ms. exp/call x86 ~21 ns -> ~37 ns, but only 2*(2*ceil(3 sigma)+1) calls per estimate (<= 386).
Tests passed (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true): rootJVM+rootJS Test/compile, surfaceJVM/test (88), surfaceJS/test (86), compareJVM/test (155), compareJS/test (155), ioJVM StudioFixtureRealSuite (8), surface headerCheckAll + scalafmtCheckAll; under x86 JDK: KernelExpJvmSuite+KdeReferenceSuite+SmootherSuite (33), StudioFixtureRealSuite (8).
Open: math.pow in Bandwidth.rule / IqrBandwidth (not on SCORES path) also differs on x86 (11,925 of n=2..1e5 for pow(n,-1/6)); JS remains 1-ulp off JVM. StudioScores scaladoc still says x86_64 is unverified.
